Anil Banerjee | anil.banerjee179@example.com | +91 9845009444
Chennai

Professional Summary
Senior digital marketing professional with experience leading performance and growth initiatives across consumer tech and healthcare sectors. Proven track record optimizing acquisition funnels, improving organic search visibility, and scaling paid media programs to deliver measurable ROI. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing, Confluence, Linux

Work Experience

Senior Digital Marketing Manager, Medisure (Apr 2026 - Present)
- Led cross-channel acquisition campaigns using Google Analytics to identify high-value cohorts and optimize landing pages, increasing qualified leads by 28% in three months while reducing cost per lead by 18% (SEO, Google Analytics).
- Drove organic traffic growth through technical SEO audits and content strategy, improving core web vitals and lifting organic sessions by 22% quarter-over-quarter (SEO).
- Managed paid and organic community programs on Facebook and LinkedIn to support product launches, improving engagement rates and referral traffic (Social Media Marketing).

Performance Marketer, Ola (Aug 2024 - Mar 2026)
- Scoped and executed Google Ads campaigns focused on driver and rider acquisition, optimizing bidding strategies and creatives to lower CPA by 24% and increase conversion rate by 15% (Google Ads).
- Implemented integrated social funnels across Instagram and Facebook to re-engage dormant users, delivering a 30% uplift in return visits and measurable revenue impact (Social Media Marketing).
- Collaborated with SEO team to refine on-site content and metadata, resulting in a 14% increase in branded organic traffic and improved SERP rankings for priority terms (SEO).

Digital Marketing Manager, Swiggy (Sep 2018 - Jul 2024)
- Owned end-to-end performance acquisition programs leveraging Google Ads to scale campaigns for new city launches, achieving target sign-ups within budget and improving conversion efficiency (Google Ads).
- Used Google Analytics to build dashboards tracking funnel drop-offs and lifetime value cohorts, enabling data-driven optimizations that reduced onboarding friction and improved retention metrics (Google Analytics).
- Launched social-first campaigns across Twitter and Instagram to drive brand affinity and incremental orders during peak promotions, contributing to double-digit uplift in campaign ROI (Social Media Marketing).

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
